name: Sarah Ball
sources: Ancestry.com, 1850 United States Federal Census (Subdivision 22, Meigs County, Tennessee)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree" (tree 4662169)
notes: Child of David Tate Ball and Draden (Davis) Ball; a sister of Ellen Rogers (Ball) McPhail. Aged 13 in 1850. The Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett tree calls her Sarah Jane and gives her death as 1880.
